title: Riffle
description: A thick flip book of 24 pencil drawings traced from a 1909 Tinker card. Thumb the corner and riffle: each page bends, flicks past and lands, so the speed of your thumb is the frame rate.
intent: One physical object finished to the edge: card-stock pages that bend as stiff sheets and flick off your thumb one at a time, so the swing plays at whatever speed your hand riffles it, forward or back.
